claim_boundary: Post-exposure conditional pairing of GENECLASS2 inferred sources among sampled reference populations; not observed natal dispersal, true dispersal preference, a causal habitat filter, or independent EOG predictive validation

null_definition.inference: Within each source year, random recombination of the exact marginal distribution of genetically assigned source labels over the same observed destination rows; target-year count and repeated row multiplicity fixed; no same-patch pseudo-route

distance.name: Mean across target patch-years of within-target median log(1+assigned source-to-target km)
distance.per_year_direction: 5/5 source years smaller than conditional null mean

ordinal_host_gap.name: Mean across target patch-years of within-target median max absolute 2019 t-1 Plantago/Veronica ordinal source-target difference
ordinal_host_gap.per_year_direction: 3/5 years smaller, 2/5 years larger than conditional null mean
ordinal_host_gap.note: Nominal whole-archipelago host alignment does NOT persist within narrow distance-matched source opportunities, so independent host filtering is not supported.

distance_matched_host_opportunity.caliper: absolute source-target distance difference <=max(0.5 km, 0.25*original assigned distance)

assigned_origins_observed_anywhere_in_al.note: Conditioning on an *assigned-origin-label roster* is not identical to a complete GENECLASS2 sampled-reference roster.

distance_matched_host_opportunity.interpretation: All four descriptive differences are positive; a lower ordinal gap for the observed assigned origin relative to geographically matched alternatives is not observed. No p-value or causal selection claim is attached.

scientific_limits: Genetic source assignment used GENECLASS2 and sampled previous-year reference populations; genetic similarity, spatial IBD, source/reference sampling and filtering can favor local assignment even without behavioral preference.
1999 null permutations condition on successful/selected genetically assigned origin labels and their frequencies, not complete source opportunity or origin assignment probabilities.
The 163 family/destination rows include repeat families and are sampled from only 100 of 1465 EOG-eligible destination patch-years; target-equal weighting does not solve selection.
Host scores (Plantago/Veronica) spatially covary with distance; naive global host permutation is confounded.
Distance-matched opportunity pools are proxies, not verified GENECLASS2 actual reference-panel membership, and the caliper is a sensitivity design.
No per-assignment quality score in uploaded data, no independent direct movement tracking, and no patch-specific detection histories.
